context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase C+D+E testing complete. All features verified: (1) My Day panel on Command Centre shows Assigned Guests, My Tasks, Active Tickets, Departures Today. (2) Self-service page at /my-registration loads registration by mobile, shows Edit button before cutoff. (3) Thank You page redesigned with animated success icon and 3-step timeline (Edit until May 19, Locked on May 19, Final on May 21). (4) Country code selector with search in OTP input. (5) Large language toggle below step progress. (6) Field renames: Additional Phone Number, Relation with Reference Person, Preferred Language for Communication. (7) Travel Mode dropdown (own_car, train, flight, bus, other) and Travel Details textarea in Step 2. (8) Stay calculation shows as large highlighted card with dates and day count. (9) Summary step shows Travel Mode and Travel Details. (10) OTP verification for existing user redirects to /my-registration. (11) Expected Guest List has Reference Person and Relation filters. (12) Room Management has vacancy forecast panel (when all rooms occupied). (13) Message Center has Schedule tab with add schedule dialog (date/time/template/target/recurring). (14) Quick Guide training section visible in sidebar at top. (15) WhatsApp confirmation MOCKED after registration (logged in message_deliveries).
